item.description:
Beta build. Replaces build 94, which was withdrawn before release.

  • Fixes a crash during a session. A timing calculation on the drawing path could overflow and terminate the app after a few minutes of streaming. Found in testing; build 94 was never published.
  • Hardens six more places with the same flaw. The same unsafe time arithmetic appeared elsewhere, including one fed by a value the remote host sends back. All now handled safely.
  • No change to video decoding. The decode path is byte-for-byte identical to build 93.

Divergence 1.5.1 (88)

  • The launcher menu now shows a map of the other machine's monitors, laid out the way they actually sit. Click one to switch to it.
  • The same map is available in Divergence mode with ⌘⌥M, where the launcher menu can't be opened. Escape closes it; press Escape again to leave Divergence mode.
  • On Windows hosts, right-clicking a window's title bar now offers "Send to Divergence display".

Divergence 1.5.1 (87)

  • Fixes switching displays on Mac. In 86 a switch that worked was still reported as failed, and the display indicator jumped back. Please update.

If you are on 86, switching displays is unreliable until you install this.
